target_customer: Indian salaried individuals, non-resident Indians, then businesses and chartered accountants paying for tax filing, GST and invoicing software
problem: Indian income tax filing was complicated, and the government's own online filing software was hard to use.
business_model: freemium consumer tax filing with paid plans and CA assisted filing, later B2B SaaS for GST, invoicing and financial products

founders.name: Archit Gupta
founders.background_notes: Previously an engineer at Data Domain (acquired by EMC) per TechCrunch 2014-06-24.

founders.name: Srivatsan Chari
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page.

founders.name: Ankit Solanki
founders.background_notes: Listed as founder on YC page.

founders.name: Raja Ram Gupta
founders.background_notes: Archit's father, a chartered accountant, named co-founder by TechCrunch 2014-06-24; not on YC page.

competitors.name: Indian government online filing software
competitors.what: Official e-filing utility, described as complicated to use
competitors.traction_then: 30 million returns filed online in India in 2014 per later coverage

competitors.name: H&R Block India
competitors.what: Launched an Indian tax filing website the previous year

technical_complexity.rationale: Had to encode Indian tax rules and integrate with government filing systems, with seasonal load, but this was standard web engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated filer history, CA network and brand trust built over time, though tax calculators were copyable by rivals like Taxspanner.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent absorbed it; ClearTax outgrew the older filers and expanded into GST, invoicing and wealth products, rebranding to Clear in June 2021.

market_need_then: Over 300,000 people used ClearTax the prior year (TechCrunch 2014-06-24), and 30 million returns were filed online in India in 2014, with a government tool users found hard.

branding.name_origin: The company name states the job: make tax filing clear. No founder source stating the origin was read.
branding.domain_note: Uses cleartax.in and cleartax.com; later clear.in for the umbrella brand. Acquisition details not found.

identity.logo: new Clear identity introduced in 2021; design not described in sources read
identity.voice_and_tone: simplicity and trust, tagline focused on simplifying finances

rebrands.why: Offerings had outgrown a tax-only name; Clear became an umbrella across taxes, invoices, wealth and credit

brand_strength.rationale: Became a leading Indian tax filing brand with millions of filers per company site, and the name made the value proposition obvious.

pivots.to: Full stack finance platform under the Clear name (taxes, invoices, wealth, credit)
pivots.why: Expansion beyond tax; announced as umbrella identity

outcome_analysis: ClearTax rode the shift to online tax filing in India, going from about 300,000 filers in 2014 to three priced rounds ending with a $75M Series C in 2021 and a team of about 900. It later hit friction: layoffs of roughly 16 percent in August 2025 after no fresh round since 2021, showing that broader fintech expansion needed cost discipline.
notes: Series C figure also confirmed by Business Today and Entrepreneur India; company says total raised over $140M. Series B participants of Sequoia and SAIF differ by outlet; only the lead Composite is recorded. A pre-Series A $2M from Founders Fund and Sequoia appears in a search snippet and is not recorded as a round. Layoff percentages vary by outlet (16 percent company, 20 to 25 percent others).
